name: E&O
recent: E&O 公布季度业绩，营收与净利同比上升，并宣布每股 1 仙中期股息。执行主席与执行董事通过 Amazing Parade Sdn Bhd 在公开市场持续增持股份。此外，公司此前与 OCK 集团宣布在 Andaman Island 合作开发数字基础设施的联营计划。
notable: 宣布每股 1 仙单层中期股息，除息日为 2026 年 12 月 18 日。
执行主席与执行董事通过 Amazing Parade Sdn Bhd 在公开市场多次增持公司股份。
与 OCK 集团计划以 49:51 比例联营，在 Andaman Island 开发数字基础设施。
risks: 董事及大股东在闭门交易期内外持续申报股权变动。
ICULS 转换为普通股导致股本增加，最新发行股本约 25.22 亿股。
earnings: 最新季度（截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日）营收为 MYR 281.47 million，同比上升 53.4%，环比上升 19.3%；净利为 MYR 58.11 million，同比上升 27.9%，环比下降 6.3%；净利率为 20.6%，低于上一季度的 26.3%。

recent_en: E&O reported higher year-on-year revenue and net profit for the quarter and declared a 1 sen interim dividend. The Executive Chairman and Executive Director continued to acquire shares in the open market via Amazing Parade Sdn Bhd. The company had earlier announced a joint venture with OCK Group for digital infrastructure on Andaman Island.
notable_en: Declared a 1 sen single-tier interim dividend, with ex-date on 18 December 2026.
Executive Chairman and Executive Director acquired shares in the open market multiple times via Amazing Parade Sdn Bhd.
Plans a 49:51 joint venture with OCK Group to develop digital infrastructure on Andaman Island.
risks_en: Directors and substantial shareholders continued to report changes in interests during and around the closed period.
Conversion of ICULS into ordinary shares increased share capital, with latest issued shares at approximately 2.522 billion.
earnings_en: For the latest quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 281.47 million, up 53.4% year-on-year and 19.3% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 58.11 million, up 27.9% year-on-year but down 6.3% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 20.6%, lower than 26.3% in the previous quarter.
